metadata.description: The IPOR Fusion TAU InfiniFi Pointsmax ($TAUSIUSD) token represents an ERC-4626 vault position curatored by IPOR Fusion and TAU Labs, optimized for the TAU infiniFi Pointsmax - Leveraged Looping strategy. In the event of prolonged borrow rate spikes, automated deleveraging engages via the infiniFi smart contract itself, bypassing external liquidity venues to fully avoid swap-related slippage and fees. The vault enforces a fixed maximum capacity of 6,928,553 USDC to manage systemic risk and support predictable point distribution. All reward reinvestment and leveraged rebalancing are conducted on-chain through deterministic mechanisms, minimizing manual intervention. No cross-asset strategies or off-platform asset exposures are executed; all activity remains solely within the USDC, siUSD, and siUSD/USDC Morpho lending loop. Fee mechanics are built into the strategy’s automatic compounding and reward-optimization workflows, enhancing both realized stablecoin yield and infiniFi points crediting.
